predeclared_reporting_rules: Report calibrated coverage and interval width together.
Report abstention rate and selective risk rather than pooling unsupported outputs.
Report reaction family scores separately from unique reaction identification.
Report conditional kinetic identifiability and k-times-A confounding explicitly.
Require calibrated discrepancy and converged model averaging before integrated claims.
Require truth-blind prospective policy selection and cost-adjusted paired uncertainty.
Use ABSTAIN when field or universal-superiority evidence is absent.

statistical_contrasts.multiple_comparison_policy: component_gate_results are reported separately; no pooled universal claim
